subject: Yes Take The Bikes But Not The Box
author: ichienkai
body:
I'm taking the xbox to my deathbed Bootleg so hands off - you are welcome to the bikes though,  if we make it back and I get my Fireblade back on the road then I aint gonna need the XR125 anyway soooo that'll be a very very cheap bike for someone... Yup i'll be taking a camera for prosperity - here is a link my buddy sent me last night of the Bonanza http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nwFLVWuIRUg Looks pretty fast...

He made me chuckle the other day saying he'll be controlling my diet so I dont contribute to any deadly gasses in the cockpit hahaha Today when I told him about this site and my "japanese" tag (he speaks Jap) he told me the word for Fart Champion in Jap which I think will be my next tag lol 😎

--Bootleg is a window lickin' stalker--

subject: you could be the next....
author: BootlegGiant
body:
dude if you get eaten by Jaws, can I have your bikes and xbox..

have you ever thought about doing a video diary about your trip and the crazy antics you get up to over the Atlantic Ocean..

I dunno man 2 guy's in a plane for how many days, how well do you know this dude, the last thing you want is for him to declare his love for you at 10,000 feet

in no way is this post ment to sound sarcastic in any way.

subject: Adventure
author: ichienkai
body:
I wouldnt say fun Suf I would say down right crazy putting my life in someone elses hands but hell you only live once and a PSP was top of my list Zom; I've never played legends or Dominator (is that what they are called - ahh memory and old age don't you love it) but I like Poker so was gonna buy another PSP but truth be told I want my eyes on the skies, don't wanna miss a damn thing. Saying that, if we crash in the Atlantic maybe a I could beat a shark around the head with a PSP? Maybe not 😉

--Bootleg is a window lickin' stalker--

subject: What you should take..
author: ZombieTron
body:
a PSP with Burnout Legends and Dominator!!

Sounds like a BIG adventure! I'm looking forward to reading your blogs about it!

🙂

--- The Original and the Best ---

subject: Looking forward to that
author: SUFFUR
body:
Sounds like a fun thing to do. A freind of mine delivered a sail boat to Greece from England once, and they had to drive it, sorry, tow it over land, and some of the stories that go with that adventure are scarey but fun at the same time.

And all you need it a good pair of lips and a clean bum, so you can kiss your arse good bye, other than that think what the A Team will do, and hope your imagination is better than a bunch of writers, lol.

Anyway got to get back to my blog writting, yes people another one, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
